meta.description: UK-headquartered lower-mid-market private equity firms and their portfolio companies.
meta.scope: Firms headquartered and investing primarily in the UK, typically writing equity cheques of ~£2m-£50m into businesses with enterprise value of ~£5m-£150m (MBOs, MBIs, development capital, buy-and-build). Excludes pure VC, large-cap/upper-mid-market buyout houses and non-UK-headquartered funds.

status_values.active: Held by the firm as of last_checked
